text:
Alex: Heads-up: noticed ~10% tail latency increase on int8 routing after last merge (merge sha def456) during high QPS. Profiling attached.
Maya: saw similar on our canary. Is this related to the prefetch sampling tweak?
CI Bot: perf-ci: throughput dropped 9.6% on int8-kv workload (job #4523) https://ci.example/4523 :warning:
Sam: can you paste the pprof flame or a hotstack?
Alex: quick stack from pprof:
```
# samples  time   function
420   62.3%  dequant::invoke
150   22.3%  kvcache::probe_and_prefetch
80    11.8%  kernel_selector::choose
```
Tariq: that points to more work in the dequant hot path. My hypothesis: increased prefetch sampling caused extra kv probes that miss and trigger dequant work.
Li: confirmed from traces: kvcache_miss_rate jumped from 3% -> 8% and avg dequant_cpu_ms/token +0.9ms after the merge
Maya: can we replicate locally with env flags?
Sam: repro with FLAGS_KV_PREFETCH_SAMPLING=0.5 on a 32-token workload. Also try quant profiles int8 vs fp8.
Alex: starting a bisect now across merges between abc000..def999
Ops Bot: bisect-triggered: range abc000..def999, bisect job #987
Alex: bisect result: culprit commit def456 "increase kv prefetch sampling for microbatch workloads" — correlates with perf spike
Maya: revert asap on canary + open hotfix for release branch
Tariq: note: commit improved microbatch recall on a small eval set. Tradeoff: perf vs quality.
Li: opened PR: revert + telemetry + a gated experiment flag https://git/rev/789
Sam: CI run after revert: perf back to baseline. Preparing hotfix CHERRY-PICK
CI Bot: perf-ci: job #4527 passed. throughput delta <1% :white_check_mark:
Maya: follow-ups: add a microbench for kv-prefetch sampling, add regression guard in perf CI for dequant_ms/token
Alex: agree. Assigning perf card ENG-PI-204 to track reintroducing sampling with adaptive gating
Maya: closing thread — will notify product about quality tradeoffs
Alex: :thumbsup:
